messages:
teresa: Heads-up — planning to flip feature flag `enable_new_routing` from 0% -> 10% at 22:00 PST tonight, then 10% -> 50% at 22:30 if smoke looks good. Who can push and who will own smoke/rollback?
maria: I can be the pusher. I have to head out by 22:20 so prefer to do the 10% flip and hand off monitoring to someone else for the 22:30 bump.
aj: I can monitor the metrics and watch logs for the 22:00 flip. Not able to push.
sahil: I can run the smoke checks post-flip (latency, 5xx rate, tail p95). Share the smoke script and where to check dashboards.
luca: +1 to having a clear kill-switch. Suggest default remains OFF and we flip via config-service so rollback is single command. Also recommend running a small synthetic traffic job for 5m after flip.
teresa: Good call. Pusher: @maria. Smoke: @aj + @sahil. Rollback owner: @maria (initial), but ops can take over. I'll open the handoff thread 21:45.
maria: Copy. Smoke checklist I expect:
- p95 latency < baseline + 30ms
- error rate (5xx) < 0.5% absolute increase
- token cost per request no >10% jump
- no model OOMs/logs about kv cache misses skyrocketing
sahil: I'll run these. Where to get quick queries?
teresa: Dashboards: https://console.redwood.local/dashboards/route_performance and /alerts. Logs: https://logs.redwood.local/query?q=enable_new_routing
Also synthetic job: `scripts/synth_runner --target routing-canary --duration 300 --qps 5`
maria: Command I'll run to flip 10%:
```
config-service set enable_new_routing=true --scope=10pct --actor=maria --desc="10pct canary 22:00 PST"
```
teresa: And the 50% bump:
```
config-service set enable_new_routing=true --scope=50pct --actor=maria --desc="50pct bump if smoke ok"
```
maria: Rollback shorthand in case of problems:
```
config-service set enable_new_routing=false --actor=maria --desc="rollback - issue detected"
```
luca: If we need emergency kill, ops can toggle global safe-default in VPC control plane: `admin-kill-switch set enable_new_routing false` (propagates immediately).
aj: I'll watch these queries once flip is live: p95, 5xx, queue depth on inference workers, kv-cache evictions.
sahil: I'll post results below after 2 minutes and 6 minutes: short form like `2m: p95=120ms, 5xx=0.02%`
deploy-bot: Scheduled config change queued by maria for 2654321000-22:00 PST. Will post confirmation when applied.
ops-bot: Created ephemeral channel #deploy-2654321000 for post-flip chatter. Join if you're watching.
maria: Doing the 10% now in 3m. I'll ping when submitted.
(3 minutes pass)
maria: submitted flip command. deploy-bot: config change applied: enable_new_routing=10% by maria at 22:00:12 PST.
aj: 2m check: p95 increased +12ms, 5xx unchanged, queue depth normal.
sahil: 6m check: p95 stable, 5xx 0.03%, no OOM logs. Synthetic run OK.
luca: Looks healthy. Proceeding to 50% in 5m?
maria: Can do the 50% bump in 5m. Handing monitoring to @aj and @sahil for the next 20. I'll be reachable on phone.
aj: Watching. If 5xx > 0.5% or p95 > baseline + 30ms, we call rollback.
sahil: Affirm. I'll post the 2m/6m snaps again.
(5 minutes pass)
maria: executing 50% bump now.
deploy-bot: config change applied: enable_new_routing=50% by maria at 22:35:02 PST.
aj: 2m check after 50%: p95 +18ms, 5xx +0.1% absolute, tail OK.
sahil: 6m check: p95 holding, 5xx 0.12%, no new errors in logs.
luca: :white_check_mark: Good. Recommend leave at 50% for 24h and collect more metrics, then gradual full rollout.
maria: Agreed. Setting follow-up ticket for metric regression check tomorrow morning. Thanks all for quick turn.
teresa: Nice job team. We'll keep the safe-default = OFF in config-service but add a note to incident runbook for emergency kill path.
maria: adding runbook entry now.
ops-bot: #deploy-2654321000 will auto-archive in 6 hours.
teresa: Closing the thread here. If anything regresses, call the rollback and ping infra oncall. :thumbsup:
